"It's all based on trust." As Dresden, Ivan Smagghe and Manfredas have slow-burned their way to becoming one of the underground's most devoutly loved duos. (Subscribe to our channel: https://www.youtube.com/residentadvisor) In our latest Art of DJing film, the two artists go deep on their hard-to-define sound and DJ style, as well as the key components that make up their legendary all-night marathons, which often run into the afternoon. "I hate the term b2b. What we do is called 'playing together.'" - Ivan Smagghe Director & Editor - Jerry Dobson Camera Operators - Fahad Akinsanya, Jerry Dobson Sound Mixer - Guy Clarke Photographer - Ollo Weguelin Special thanks to - Brilliant Corners, The Nickle Cinema & Tollington's Fish Bar ----------------------- Website: https://ra.co Follow us: https://www.tiktok.com/@residentadvisor https://www.instagram.com/resident_advisor/ https://www.facebook.com/residentadvisor/

“I was a hip-hop dancer before I was a DJ, so hip-hop culture was my very first love.” (Subscribe to our channel: https://www.youtube.com/residentadvisor) Lady Shaka’s Greenhouse Sessions is an ode to the music that made her who she is. Played on AlphaTheta’s DJM-V5 mixer and the CDJ-3000X, the set draws on music from Aotearoa (New Zealand), where she was born, and nods to her Samoan heritage. The Afro Pasifika artist set out to showcase rap and hip-hop lyrics in Samoan, Te reo Māori and more. "We never prepare a DJ set. We just meet together and it explodes."   Almost 20 years into their career, exuberant techno duo FJAAK still treat the booth like their playground. Hailing from the Berlin borough of Spandau, the pair's obsession with groove, and the gear that makes it, underpins everything they do.   In partnership with @watchAIAIAI, our latest Art of DJing goes deep on FJAAK's new hybrid live show, spotlighting locked groove dubplates, syncing their 909 to vinyl and incorporating hardware into their sets.
